description:
Summarizes the reader's ReadingRate reading record: reading speed from their logged sessions, the difficulty range they usually read, their most-read genres and themes, books per month, and how they rate books.

Use when the user asks how fast they read, what difficulty suits them, what genres or themes they read most, or how their ratings are spread.
name: get_reading_stats

genre_preferences.description: Top genres with count, percentage, average_rating

confidence.description: "low" means too few logged sessions: the speed is the average reader's, not the reader's own

title: Get reading statistics
